title: 7 weeks Gym lean strength posture
author: Selvan A
desc: Transform your fitness journey with the Selvan Boostcamp Workout, a 7-week program designed to enhance your gym posture and overall strength. Committing to 5 days a week, you’ll engage in a balanced mix of resistance training and mobility work, focusing on building a solid foundation for your lifts. Each session is structured around three sets, ensuring you maximize your time and results. Elevate your performance, improve your alignment, and unlock your full potential in just over a month!
